sections.title: Nélkül
sections.content: *Nélkül* means "without". It works like the place words: it follows the noun, and the noun does not change. *Cukor nélkül kérem a teát.* (I would like the tea without sugar.) *Esernyő nélkül megyek.* (I am going without an umbrella.) The rest of the sentence is as usual: *kérem* goes with a known thing (*a teát*).

sections.title: With a person
sections.content: Use a person in the same way: *Anna nélkül nem megyek moziba.* (I am not going to the cinema without Anna.) *Nem* stands before the verb.

items.english: I would like the tea without sugar.
I am going without an umbrella.
I am not going home without a key.
I am not going to the cinema without Anna.

sections.content: Do not add *-t* or *-val* to the noun before *nélkül*: *cukor nélkül*, not *cukrot nélkül* or *cukorral nélkül*.
